name: express-react-typescript-nextjs
description: Next.js with TypeScript and Less - SSR enabled for AWS Lambda deployment

scripts.verify-css-minification: echo 'Checking CSS minification...' && find .next/static/css -name '*.css' -exec sh -c 'echo "File: {}"; head -c 200 "{}" | tr -d "\n" | wc -c' \;
scripts.build:production: NODE_ENV=production npm run build && npm run verify-css-minification
